Asian Games 2026 Open in Japan with Indian Athletes Competing

The Asian Games 2026 have commenced in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. The Indian contingent, led by Bhaker and Sehrawat, is participating in various events. Prime Minister Modi extended his best wishes to the athletes. In early competitions, Elavenil Valarivan secured her second silver medal in the 10m air rifle final. Quimcy Dsouza lost in the Teqball semifinal, though medal hopes remain for some athletes. Reports also indicate issues such as cruise ship cabin problems and kit chaos at the event.
